column3: Home shows 8+ sections competing for attention. Fix: ONE dynamic priority card at top — live class > upcoming > due > resume > "all caught up." Everything else below the fold.
AI Tutor promo card sells a feature the user already has. Remove all promotional cards. AI should be woven into workflows, not advertised.
Grade page is data-dense. Lead with "You're doing fine" or "CSE110 needs attention." Details behind a tap. First screen = emotional reassurance, not a dashboard.
Tutor requires picking a course every time. Should remember last course and open directly. If user was viewing Pointer Arithmetic, Tutor should pre-load that topic.
Rings navigate to detail page, not to the action. Fix: Absorb → lecture player. Retrieve → practice quiz. Apply → next assignment. Each shows micro-label: "8 min left." ONE tap.
10+ sidebar items. Student needs: Home, Courses, Grades, Tutor. Schedule → tab in Courses. Practice → inside Courses. Usage/Settings → inside Profile. Mobile bottom nav: 4 items.
Queue shows 9 items at once. Add "Review all" focus mode: one submission full-screen, AI draft visible, Approve/Edit, auto-advance. Progress bar (1/9). "All caught up" completion state.
Quiz generation requires navigating to Copilot, selecting materials, configuring count. Too many clicks. Fix: "Generate quiz for this chapter" button inline on the course content page.
At-risk flags show info but no actions. Each needs: "Send check-in" (pre-drafted message), "View profile," "Flag to advisor." Insight without action = anxiety.
Faculty needs: Home, Courses, Grading, Copilot. "Record" and "Live" are action buttons, not sidebar destinations. Remove Copilot promo card from home.
Dr. Kamrul Hasan (wired demo teacher per PRD §8) NOT found in faculty picker. The "find yourself" moment is the pitch's emotional core. Must be in the list.
Needs You, Timeline, Performance at equal weight. 99% pass rate doesn't need the Chair. Fix: Top 70% = "Needs Your Decision" (counts down). Below = "Department Health" (collapsed).

Analyst AI is the killer feature — answers with cited sources in ~3 sec. But hidden behind sidebar. Fix: When no decisions remain, Analyst becomes home hero: "Nothing needs you. Anything you want to know?"
5 sections shown equally, but CSE110 Sec 3 (97%, -2% vs avg) needs attention; others are routine. Fix: Sort by anomaly. Visual accent on flagged sections. "Certify all routine" batch button.

Only 2 of 10 intents tested — both worked perfectly. Need to verify remaining 8: top-marks, at-risk, weakest-course, eligibility-barred, certification-pending, teacher-load, term-compare, dept-summary.

Home leads with handoffs (Flag to Chair, Export). Coordinator's question is "Is the data clean?" Fix: Lead with completeness checklist. "267 faculty (complete). 162 students. 1 section unstaffed (flagged)."
Drop zone is good, but coordinator fears "Did I break something?" Fix: After drop, show preview: "42 will be added. 3 exist (skip). 0 errors." Table of first 10 rows. Button: "Import 42."
Cmd+K search does NOT respond in any role. Neither shortcut nor click works. This is a false affordance (PRD §29) — a control that looks interactive but does nothing. Fix immediately.
No dark/light mode toggle found. Site stuck in dark mode. PRD §10 says theme persists locally. Users in bright classrooms need light mode. Add sun/moon toggle in header.
Data is consistent across roles (CSE221 Sec 2 unstaffed in Admin + Coordinator, dates match). But no transition tested — can coordinator flag → admin assign → offering update? Loops = thesis proof.
Empty states need warmth. "No class live" → "CSE220 tomorrow at 10 AM." Grading done → "All caught up — students see feedback today." Every empty state = reduce anxiety or build confidence.
Students check between classes on phone. Bottom nav below lg breakpoint with 4 items per role. Primary actions in thumb zone. No horizontal scroll at 375px. Modals full-screen on mobile.
Live class banner visible (31/35 joined) but never entered. Broadcast, chat auto-scroll, raise-hand, polls, no-class empty state — all untested. Core "Learn" pillar from sales deck.
Player never opened. Synced transcript, jump-to-moment, Smart Class AI panel, autoplay — untested. This is where "never miss a class" value proposition lives.
Gradebook exists (section filters work, 105 students). CSV export button present but not clicked. PRD §28 says this is "genuinely functional." Must verify it downloads a real Excel-friendly file.
Green Room → Live, Record studio with topic tagging, quiet publish — all untested. Core "Live" edition feature.
